name: comp-329
blurb: Checkout dialog for subscription billing with plan selection and card payment.
description: A shadcn Dialog with radio-button plan selector (Monthly/Yearly), card details via react-payment-inputs, optional coupon input, and subscribe button.
use_when: Collecting subscription payments with plan choice and optional promotional codes.
avoid_when: For complex pricing tiers or per-seat calculations — this form handles simple binary plan choice.
a11y: Plan radio buttons are keyboard-navigable; card fields properly labeled; coupon input auto-focuses when shown; full keyboard support.
